Implemented Rule A: einstein/cross_pollination.py::detect_cross_pollination(methods, domains, edges, similarity_threshold=0.2, embedder=None) -> list[CrossPollinationCandidate]. Fits one embedder over method+domain text (embed_groups, same pattern as gaps.py::detect_gaps), finds each method paper's closest domain paper by cosine similarity, flags it when similarity >= threshold AND no einstein.openalex_fetcher.Edge connects the two paper ids in either citation direction. Reuses gaps.Match for the evidence record. 13 new tests in tests/test_cross_pollination.py (candidate surfaced/suppressed by edge presence and direction, per-pair suppression specificity, threshold gating, self-match exclusion, non-paper-type assertions, default-threshold behavior, CrossPollinationCandidate invariants). Module docstring states the id-space caveat explicitly: methods/domains/edges must share an id scheme (OpenAlex short ids from fetch_work_by_doi/fetch_citation_edges) -- this module does no cross-scheme id resolution (e.g. arXiv id vs OpenAlex short id), same as gaps.py's own documented limits. Not wired into einstein/graph.py or einstein/cli.py -- filed as follow-up (see new bead). Full suite: 244 tests OK (uv run python -m unittest discover tests).
